title: 2000-10-26 10:26:20.00 — datum-zero anchor on the number line
role: 0d reference datum; both calendar renderings are divisor-rich and digit-sum-palindromic.

verification.shared_structure: 2^4 x 5^3 x p (two primes) -> (4+1)(3+1)(2)(2) = 80 divisors in both directions
verification.method: exact factorization + divisor count computed with integer arithmetic

exact_count_2000.parity_note: all 17 are even-month/even-day; the date (10,26) is one of them

year_2007_comparison.reading: the tau=80 both-orientation property is a trailing-000 (year-2000) artifact; tau=8 agreement is the generic small-tau coincidence

null_analysis.reading: rare among arbitrary 8-digit numbers; common within year-2000 (trailing 000 inflates tau >= 16); both-orientation agreement ~1 in 22. A mild, real coincidence, not a law.
null_analysis.clock_time_tau_note: tau(37580)=12 equals tau(60) and tau(260): the sexagesimal and tzolkin divisor counts.

base_invariance.test: tau-equality of the orientation pairs when the digit strings are re-encoded in bases 8, 10, 12, 16
base_invariance.reading: agreement survives decimal AND duodecimal encoding, breaks in octal and hexadecimal. Base-selective, not convention-free. Note that 12^2 = 144 and 10^2 = 100 are the two bases whose squares are divisor-rich.

scale_dependence.reading: tau-equality under MM/DD swap OSCILLATES with scale: holds at 2, 5, 6, 8 digits; breaks at 3, 4, 14. Not a systematic law; a scale-dependent coincidence.

8digit_digits_20001026.note: tau=8 is the mode among ALL permutations of the date's 8 digits; the 80-pair sits in a 3.6% family.

divisors_80.factor_shape: 2^4 x 5^3 x p x q (exponent signature 4,3,1,1) for both; p,q = 7,733 vs 31,421
divisors_80.gcd_note: the year itself is the greatest common divisor; the 20 shared divisors are exactly the divisors of 2000 (tau=20)
divisors_80.self_reference: the divisor count 80 divides both numbers (80 = 2^4 x 5 is a common divisor)

cross_scale_nesting.note: the 5-digit pair appears as divisors of the 8-digit pair (x1000); the retrace-chain members are divisors of the epoch

non_divisors.note: the day 26 does not divide either number (26 = 2x13, no factor 13); only the year 2000 and the trailing 1000 structure divide

odd_odd_prime_gaps.note: differences of odds are even, so the only prime gap possible is 2. A has exactly one: 5 and 7 are CONSECUTIVE odd divisors AND twin primes. B has none.

even_even_prime_gaps.note: both even sets share the same two gap-2 twins at the bottom, from the common year-lattice divisors.

signature_prime_as_doubling_difference.note: each number's own large prime p yields a prime cross-parity difference by doubling, since p (odd) and 2p (even) are both divisors.

shared_prime_difference.7: |1 - 8| in BOTH A and B (1 odd, 8 even, both common divisors)

chain_reemergence_as_gaps.note: the 5-digit pair re-appears as gaps between consecutive even divisors; 733-multiple and 421-multiple gaps form ladders in A and B respectively.

gap_and_difference_analysis.small_prime_ubiquity: cross-parity differences produce 65 (A) and 59 (B) distinct primes, starting 3,5,7,11,13,17,19,23,31,43 - small primes are unavoidable from a dense divisor lattice, so only the specific ones above are diagnostic.

note: Both orientations of the date share divisor count (80) and digit sum (11): the anchor is orientation-stable under MM/DD <-> DD/MM at several scales. See docs/WEAVERS_SCRIBE.md for the cultural mapping and the binding creases.

prime_pairings.rule: each number carries exactly one Mersenne prime (mod4=3) and one sum-of-two-squares prime (mod4=1)
prime_pairings.root_sum_coincidence: both two-square primes have square-roots summing to 29 (prime)

gcd_triangle.note: A-B edge is the year 2000; B-C edge is the Mersenne 31 (2^5 - 1); A-C coprime. B is the hub.

three_way_connection.B_is_hub: B=2^4*5^3*31*421 shares a factor with both others (2000 with A, 31 with C); B/31=842000=2000*421, C/31=61757

chain_mod31_ladder.note: the two 31-multiples (C and the DD tail) bracketed by +-1: 730421=31*23562-1, 10262=31*331+1

three_way_connection.prime_distribution_up_chain: 26102=2*31*421; 31 lands in C=31*61757, 421 surfaces in 730421 (contains 421; 730421 mod 421 = 407 = 11*37), 2 stays in the tail
three_way_connection.no_date_part_arithmetic: no expression over {26,10,2000,1026,2610,300,37580} constructs C=1914467 exactly; connection is factorization- and chain-structural, not digit-arithmetic

counts.note: odd count 16 = 2^4 = 2^v2 is determined solely by the 2-adic exponent, NOT by the odd primes; even = 16*4 = 64; tau = 16*5 = 80

odd_parts.note: families share only the 5^3 block; they separate entirely on the odd side

year_2000_pairing.note: 5131 = 7*733 and 13051 = 31*421 are the chain tails' odd parts; the date numbers are (tail odd-core) x 2000

odd_divisor_pairings.shared_even_complements_note: = 2^4 x {1,5,25,125} = 2^4 x shared odd divisors; tau=80 self-reference appears as an even complement (128275 x 80 in A, 65255 x 80 in B)

odd_bridge_to_chain.note: the 31-bridge is odd-only: the chain fold connects to B purely through the odd core; the 2^4*5^3 scaffolding is irrelevant

E1_dozenal_match.note: the toy's second eigenvalue matches 1/4 + ln^2(12) to 0.04%; E0 does NOT match ln(10) (5% off)

golden_fold.note: two independent golden hits: chain rung ~ phi^2 (0.12%) and T58 closing radius ~ 1/phi (0.7%)

level_spacing_statistics.note: intermediate; cannot decide T19 chaos claim at n=30

arithmetic_functions.note: A and B highly abundant; C barely abundant (least-abundant family member)

weak_near_misses.note: all at coincidence scale (1-2%), same magnitude as already-falsified trailing-000 and base-8 artifacts

conjectures.C1: low spectral radii r_k track ln of convention-scale integers; 12 is first/cleanest; test with n>30 modes
conjectures.C2: further retrace folds lock on phi or phi^2 rungs; fold is golden-geometric (extends T58 0.6138 ~ 1/phi)
conjectures.C3: a mode exists near lambda=4.574 (from prime 7) below the current floor; lambda(31)=12.26 falls in gap [12.06,12.85]
conjectures.C4: level statistics <r>=0.46 neither Poisson nor GOE; T19 needs more modes to be measured, not asserted
